extracted.name: Christmas hot chocolate
extracted.description: Make this festive spiced instant hot chocolate powder to give to friends and family, or for stocking the storecupboard whenever you need a treat
ingredient_lines: 200ml hot whole milk or boiling water (per hot chocolate)
marshmallows (ensure vegetarian), sprinkles or chocolate shavings
instruction_lines: Mix the sugar, milk powder, cocoa, mixed spice and 1 tsp sea salt together. Store in an airtight jar or tin in a cool, dark place. Will keep for up to three months.

To make one hot chocolate, tip 3-4 tsp of the hot chocolate powder into a mug. Add a splash of hot milk or water, and whisk until smooth. Top up with the rest of the milk or water. Top with whipped cream, marshmallows, sprinkles or chocolate shavings, and garnish with a cinnamon stick to serve.
